title: 2018 AMC 10A Problem 8
statement: Joe has a collection of \(23\) coins, consisting of \(5\)-cent coins, \(10\)-cent coins, and \(25\)-cent coins. He has \(3\) more \(10\)-cent coins than \(5\)-cent coins, and the total value of his collection is \(320\) cents. How many more \(25\)-cent coins does Joe have than \(5\)-cent coins?

solutions.text:
Let \(x\) be the number of \(5\)-cent coins that Joe has. Then the number of \(10\)-cent coins he has is \(x + 3.\)

Therefore, Joe has \[ 23 - x - (x + 3) = 20 - 2x \] \(25\)-cent coins.

The total value of all these coins is \[ 5x + 10(x + 3) + 25(20 - 2x) \]\[= 530 - 35x. \]

We know that \[ 530 - 35x = 320 \Rightarrow x = 6. \]

This means that Joe has \(20 - 2 \cdot 6 = 8\) \(25\)-cent coins. Therefore, he has \(8 - 6 = 2\) more \(25\)-cent coins than \(5\)-cent coins.

Thus, C is the correct answer.
hints: Let the number of \(5\)-cent coins be \(x\)
Use both the total number of coins and total value equations
